name: Chadwick (arch comic)
sounds_like: Sits high for a male-coded voice at 167 Hz and bright with it (centroid 1986 Hz), which puts it close to androgynous. The slowest articulation in the library apart from vex - 3.8 onsets per second - with fussy, over-enunciated consonants and a 9.7-semitone rise and fall. Pauses to 0.63s for comic timing. Source line is cartoon patter, mock-alarmed and condescending.
casts_well_as: Arch comic character, fussy butler or bureaucrat, camp villain, cartoon narrator, someone enjoying their own vocabulary.
avoid_for: Deep narration, gravitas, or straight drama - despite how it is labelled elsewhere in this project. See note.
note: scripts/make_audio_library.py maps this file to narrator_deep and char_narrator. That label is wrong: measured median pitch is 167 Hz, higher than every other male-range voice in the library and 85 Hz above male_02. Use male_02 for deep narration.
